title: Sloppy Joe Baked Potatoes
description: Baked potatoes topped with saucy ground beef for an easy comfort meal.

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Pierce 4 potatoes and bake about 45–50 minutes until tender.
While potatoes bake, brown 1 pound ground beef or turkey in a skillet and drain if needed.
Stir in 1 cup sloppy joe sauce and simmer 5 minutes.
Split potatoes and spoon the sloppy joe mixture over them; add 1/2 cup cheddar if desired.

title: Mushroom Egg Fried Rice
description: Savory fried rice with mushrooms, cabbage, and fluffy egg.

steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook 8 ounces sliced mushrooms and 2 cups shredded cabbage for 5–6 minutes until browned and softened.
Push vegetables aside, scramble 3 eggs in the open space, then mix everything together.
Add 3 cups cold cooked rice and 2 tablespoons soy sauce; cook 4–5 minutes, stirring, until hot.

title: Creamy Broccoli Pasta
description: Pasta and broccoli in a light creamy Parmesan sauce.

steps.text: Boil 12 ounces pasta in salted water.
During the last 4 minutes of pasta cooking, add 4 cups broccoli to the same pot.
Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain pasta and broccoli.
Return to the pot with 1 tablespoon butter, 3/4 cup milk, 3/4 cup Parmesan, and 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder; stir over low heat until creamy, adding pasta water as needed.

title: Easy Beef & Broccoli Rice Bowls
description: Quick thin-sliced beef and broccoli in a simple savory sauce.

steps.text: Whisk 1/4 cup soy sauce, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, and 1/2 cup water.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet; cook 1 pound thin-sliced beef 3–4 minutes and transfer to a plate.
Add 5 cups broccoli and 1/4 cup water; cover 4 minutes.
Return beef to the skillet, pour in sauce, and cook 2–3 minutes until glossy and thick. Serve over 3 cups cooked rice.
